# instances

Instances are the virtual machines running in a project.

## GET /v1/instances

Operation `instance_list`.

`GET /v1/instances?tenant=&project=&image=&cn=&state=`. Returns `400 ScopeNotAccepted` if `silo=` is set (that selector is reserved for `/v1/system/instances`). Returns `400 MissingScope` if no indexed selector or project scope is set (cross-project scans on the customer surface are not supported in AP-2b; the operator surface at `/v1/system/` will accept them).

Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted today, because that is the order all three dispatch indexes are stored in; the other modes are `400 UnsupportedSortMode` rather than a silent reorder. A page under `limit` does not mean the end of the collection: `?state=` is filtered per row after the index read, so only a missing `next_page` ends the walk.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cn` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to instances placed on a single compute node. |
| `image` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to instances whose `image_id` matches. Backed by `idx/image/<image>/<instance>` in FDB (AP-1c). |
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `state` | query | no | [LifecycleStateKind](schemas.md#lifecyclestatekind) | Restrict to instances in a given lifecycle state. Bounded-scan within the resolved scope (cap `SCAN_CAP`); over-cap returns `400 ScanLimitExceeded`. Typed rather than a free string so adding a state to `LifecycleStateKind` cannot silently start matching nothing: an unrecognised value is a `400` at deserialization, and the match is an enum comparison rather than a string compare against a `Debug` rendering. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_Instance](schemas.md#resultspage_for_instance)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/instances

Operation `instance_create`.

`POST /v1/instances?tenant=&project=`. Create an instance in the named tenant and project. Answers `201` with the instance in `pending`; read it until it is `running`, or `failed` with a `reason`. `tenant` and `project` are required selectors.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewInstance](schemas.md#newinstance)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [Instance](schemas.md#instance)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## GET /v1/instances/{instance_id}/tunnel

Operation `instance_tunnel`.

Authorises via `instance_tunnel` for port 22 and `instance_port_forward` for anything else, then requires the instance to be Running and its subnet to have a relay. The relay is created on demand, so the first call for a quiet subnet answers `503` with a retry hint rather than blocking.

A refusal arrives as an HTTP status, not as a close frame, so a client can tell "retry in a moment" from "this will never work".

Scope comes from the bearer: the caller supplies an instance id and nothing else, the way `instance_start` does.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `port` | query | yes | integer (uint16) | Destination TCP port on the instance. |
| `subnet` | query | no | string (uuid) | Which of the instance's networks to reach it on. |

Responses:

- `default`: , `*/*`

## POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/kill

Operation `session_kill`.

End a live tunnel session. `404` when this node is not carrying that session. It may still be live on another node; the message says so rather than letting the caller read it as "already gone". An unauthenticated caller gets a plain `404` whatever the id, before the lookup.

## GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/instances/{instance_id}/metrics

Operation `instance_metric_view`.

Range query for the per-instance metrics chart on the VM detail view. Returns one numeric series per distinct `series` identity field encountered in the requested window. Counter datums are emitted as per-bucket deltas; gauges as last-value per bucket.

Auth: requires a tenant-scoped credential with read access to the named instance.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `project_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `device` | query | no | string | Device/pool filter for storage schemas (matches the sample's `device` identity, e.g. a pool name or `c1t2d0`). Ignored by schemas that don't carry a device. |
| `range` | query | no | string | Short range identifier (e.g. `1h`). |
| `schema` | query | no | string | Schema name. Defaults to `triton.cpu_per_zone`. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [RangeResult](schemas.md#rangeresult)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
